# discord_members (Data Source)

Lists the members of a server in ascending order of user ID. Requires the Server Members privileged intent to be enabled for the bot in the Discord Developer Portal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires the Server Members privileged intent.
data "discord_members" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}

output "bots" {
  value = [for m in data.discord_members.all.members : m.username if m.bot]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of members to return. Defaults to all of them, fetched in pages of 1000.

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `bot` (Boolean) Whether the user is a bot.
- `global_name` (String) Display name.
- `joined_at` (String) When the member joined the server.
- `nick` (String) Server nickname.
- `roles` (Set of String) IDs of the member's roles.
- `user_id` (String) User ID.
- `username` (String) Unique username.
